title: Two-Tool Electrical Projects: Lineman Pliers and a Flat-Head Screwdriver
summary: This Old House’s Ask This Old House video foregrounds a minimalist approach to basic electrical tasks, arguing that two tools—the lineman pliers and a flat-head screwdriver—are sufficient for many common jobs. The segment demonstrates wire work (cutting, stripping, and twisting/splicing), accessing electrical boxes by removing covers, and removing knockouts. It also shows using a lock-nut push tool to remove knockouts and to drive staples, with a brief note on clearing obstructions (using a chisel when needed). The tone is practical and conversational, emphasizing tool economy and flexibility over a large tool kit.
